title: @dsar/backend
description: Backend runtime core for DSAR services. `dsarInstance(options)` returns handler, app metadata, and runtime context; built on @effect/platform HTTP boundary with fetch-compatible contract.
features: Error envelope: non-success responses return ok, error.code, error.message, status
OpenAPI + docs: GET /spec.json, GET /docs, makeDsarHttpApi, createOpenApiSpec
